body:
## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b095ba02eee411e2db30b8336aa3cb8a7d7c9575`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed read-only: card #20847 (body + comments 5910732998 / 5911100852 / 5911443452), PR #20854 body, file list and net diff, PR #20845 diff, the #20695 / #6732 / #20797 timelines, the head's check-runs, and the repository at `05a7547c9` (merge base), `b095ba02e` (head), `origin/main` (`72f8c3820`) and `02ea176a1` (#20845's tip) via `git show` / `git grep` / `git diff` only. The record template was printed with `record-recognisers.mjs --template` as the brief directs; no gate, build or test was run. Not read: the dispatch order or the dispatching seat's conclusions.

**Net diff at the head.** `origin/main` moved from the PR's snapshot base to `72f8c3820` after the branch forked at `05a7547c9`; none of `AGENTS.md`, `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `platform-readings.md`, `fleet-write/ops.mjs` or `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` changed on `main` in that span, so the three-dot diff IS the net diff: 2 files, +9 / -8 (`AGENTS.md` +8 / -7 across three hunks; `SKILL.md` +1 / -1 at `:202`).

**Check-runs on the head** (`filter=latest`, 30 runs): `success` 18, `skipped` 12, no other conclusion; every run is `completed`. Every non-success run is a `skipped`: Auto Label (dup name), Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset (dup name), Check PR Size (dup name), Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke ×2, Temporal Conformance, Test Core (matrix). Of note among the greens: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Check Changeset`, the four `Type Check ·` lanes, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, and the three card/branch parity checks. PR state read: draft, auto-merge off, `mergeable_state: clean`, labels `documentation` · `size/s` · `skip-changeset`. Untouched.

### ① Derived judgments

**Prime Directive #14, `AGENTS.md:285-:288` at head — right.** Clause by clause against the timelines and the code:
- "Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to **draft**, which disarms an unqueued PR" — right. The card's three unqueued cases (#4745, #6727, #6829) log `auto_merge_disabled` within 1 s of `convert_to_draft`; #20695's own timeline shows the same pair on an unqueued PR at 18:31:59Z / 18:32:02Z. The disable is a measured relay act (`ops.mjs:213` `disablePullRequestAutoMerge`, op `automerge_disable`). The order swap from the base ("draft AND disable") is immaterial: both acts are required, and on an unqueued PR either one alone disarms.
- "no seat act, those two included, is measured to dequeue one" — right, and honestly worded (see the measurement judgment below). #6732: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-08-08T14:01:50Z, `convert_to_draft` 14:04:32Z, `merged` 14:38:56Z with `removed_from_merge_queue` by `github-merge-queue[bot]` in the same second — merged in draft. #20695: queued 2026-09-29T23:32:51Z, draft 23:57:02Z, merged 2026-09-30T00:04:21Z — merged in draft. No `removed_from_merge_queue` follows either conversion.
- "(`platform-readings.md`, queue membership)" — right as a citation form: the section `## 队列成员资格与 auto-merge` exists at that file's `:5` and holds `:41-:44`; `AGENTS.md:443-:444` already cites the same file the same way; no issue number, date or narrative enters the rule text (header `:11-:15`). Consistency of the cited section is a sequencing matter, judged below.
- "so ask the maintainer at once to remove a queued PR by hand" — right, and the one route named is the one measured: #20797 `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-09-30T07:32:47Z by `os-zhuang`, `removed_from_merge_queue` 07:33:36Z by `os-zhuang` (a human account, in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`), no `convert_to_draft` anywhere in that timeline, no red build (re-queued by the fleet bot 07:56:08Z, merged 08:20:18Z). This is the only measured removal without a red build.
- "then confirm from the remote that it is in neither the queue nor `origin/main`" and "**Draft is no barrier by itself — the barrier is this directive**" — kept verbatim from the base. The barrier still holds; the rule still forbids the seat from treating draft as the safeguard.
- Nothing true is lost: the base's "disabling alone drops only the arming" survives as "disarms an unqueued PR"; the base's "draft is what removes queue membership" is the falsified half and is the only thing removed.

**"State on your PR", `AGENTS.md:429-:430` — right.** "flipped back destroys an unqueued PR's auto-merge at once … invisibly" is the measured unqueued reading; the paragraph's rule (do not "correct" a flag another actor set) is unchanged; the pointer "(§7's draft-flip re-arm note)" still resolves to the rewritten §7 sentence at `:533`. Nothing true lost.

**Multi-agent §7, `AGENTS.md:533-:534` — right.** "flipping back to draft drops an unqueued PR's auto-merge at once, and it does not return by itself — ready *first*, arm *second*": #4745 and #6727 were re-armed only by a fresh act after ready (01:30:52Z, 13:46:02Z). "neither returns" → "it does not return" is the correct follow-through once queue membership leaves the sentence. Nothing true lost.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:202` — right, with one named residual.**
Base: 「已入队才读到本条 ⇒ 转 draft 与 disable 都做;出队以阳性探针答,ref 缺席只旁证。」 (107 bytes)
Head: 「已入队 ⇒ 转 draft 并 disable,即请维护者手动出队(席位无实测手段);出队以阳性探针答。」 (116 bytes)
- The dropped 「ref 缺席只旁证」 does live at `platform-readings.md:44`, verified at both `origin/main` and the #20845 tip, in its stronger form: 「出队按队列 ref 阳性探针答不在队向,加未落地;ref 缺席只作旁证,⛔ 永不承载结论。」 — `:44` is a context line in #20845's diff, untouched. `lanes/cli.md:17` routes queue readers to that file. The line's positive-probe half 「出队以阳性探针答」 is kept. No rule is lost.
- Dropping 「才读到本条」 widens the literal trigger from "queued by the time you first read this clause" to "queued". In its block (`## 路径分叉`, `:180`) the bullet sits after `:182` (take the path surface BEFORE ready / arm / queue) and `:186` (the Tier H fork) and its ①-④ items, and the legitimate queue entries carry their own preconditions (`:196` 批准后, `:204` PASS 后), so in context "已入队" still names the same case: a governed PR found queued ahead of its landing key. `AGENTS.md` PD14 keeps the exact trigger "Already armed or queued when you read this?", and `AGENTS.md` wins on conflict (`:6`). Residual: read in isolation the new line is literally satisfied by a Tier S PR the seat itself just queued after its PASS record, where the cost of a misread is one unnecessary manual-dequeue request to the maintainer. Restoring 「才读到本条」 costs 15 bytes (116 → 131, over the 120 cap); the only way to fit it is to drop the reason 「(席位无实测手段)」, which the triage direction requires ("says why"). The trade is forced by the pins and the direction; judged acceptable, flagged in ③ for the maintainer's eye.

**The dequeue-act measurement — the relay half verified at the code; the sentence is an honest statement.** `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` at `05a7547c9` (unchanged on `main` since): `OPS` (`:253`) has exactly the 15 keys the dev lists — comment, comment_edit, labels_add, labels_remove, assign, unassign, issue_patch, issue_create, pr_create, pr_request_reviewers, pr_ready, pr_draft, automerge_enable, automerge_disable, transfer; `PR_MUTATIONS` (`:209-:213`) carries only ready / draft / auto-merge enable / disable; `ALLOWED_MUTATIONS` (`:393`) is exactly `markPullRequestReadyForReview`, `convertPullRequestToDraft`, `enablePullRequestAutoMerge`, `disablePullRequestAutoMerge`, `transferIssue`; the strings `dequeue`, `queue`, `enqueue` do not occur in the file. The three external legs (published GraphQL schema declares `dequeuePullRequest`; live introspection 403 from the session egress; REST OpenAPI has no queue path; github/docs removal reasons) are the dev's readings of sources outside this checkout and were not re-fetched here. The rule text does not depend on them: "no seat act … is measured to dequeue one" rests on the in-repo evidence alone (four queued drafts never dequeued by the conversion; the relay carries no dequeue). The wording claims "not measured", never "does not exist", which is exactly what the evidence supports, and the PR body discloses that the platform's schema does declare one. Honest.

**The cross-file citation and sequencing.** At `origin/main` (`72f8c3820`, file identical to `05a7547c9`), `platform-readings.md:42` still reads 「本仓转 draft 同时掉 auto-merge 与队列成员资格,不自动恢复,转正后重挂;姊妹仓曾保位照合。」, while `:41` already says 「转 draft 不是可靠的踢队手段」 and `:43` already prescribes both acts. PR #20845 (head `02ea176a1`, base `30839063b`; the file is byte-identical between that base and current `main`, so it applies cleanly) rewrites `:41-:43` to the split-by-queue-state reading and leaves `:44` alone. So: this PR's sentence is true on its own; its citation is consistent with the cited section only once #20845 has landed — until then the rule and `:42` disagree, with `AGENTS.md` winning in the window. The order that keeps the two texts consistent at every moment is **#20845 first (or in the same batch), then #20854**. #20845 is Tier S and still a draft (needs its own PASS record, then the queue); #20854 is Tier H and waits on the maintainer's word anyway, so the owning seat can hold this order.

**Pins — right, measured at the head.** `AGENTS.md` 1107 → 1108 lines against ceiling 1116 (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1531`), headroom 9 → 8; `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 319 → 319 against ceiling 319 (`:374`), `:202` edited in place; every added line measured 116 / 118 / 110 / 120 / 118 / 83 / 87 / 88 / 88 bytes, max 120 against the 120-byte cap. `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on the head.

**Survivor grep at the head** (`AGENTS.md` + `.claude/**`: `queue membership`, `dequeue`, `evict`, 转 draft, 出队, 踢队, 踢出, and `draft` beside `queue`/`auto-merge`): no copy of the falsified claim remains except `platform-readings.md:41-:43`, which is #20845's. The four sites the PR body names are all of them.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right. The diff touches `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` only; neither is in any released package's `files[]`, so nothing publishes (`AGENTS.md:1072-:1076`: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package). `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body's second line and on the claim (5911100852). `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Dev deviation — `SKILL.md:202` drops 「ref 缺席只旁证」 and 「才读到本条」.** Answered above: the first has its home at `platform-readings.md:44` (verified at `main` and at #20845's tip); the second widens the literal trigger but not the practical one, bounded by the block's `:182` / `:186` / `:196` / `:204` and by `AGENTS.md` precedence. Acceptable; the maintainer may weigh whether 「已入队才读到本条」 should return in a later shrink of the line.
2. **Dev deviation — `AGENTS.md` net +1, not at most 0.** The claim stated an aim, not a pin; 1108 / 1116 holds. Acceptable.
3. **Dev deviation — the introspection is a published-schema reading, live endpoint 403.** Answered: the rule's wording is "not measured", which the in-repo evidence alone establishes; the external readings are disclosed as such in the PR body. Acceptable.
4. **Dev deviation — wording departs from the PM's suggested route.** The suggestion is not in this review's inputs; judged against the card's triage direction (5910732998) instead, every requirement is met: the falsified claim removed at all sites, the unqueued half kept, only the measured removal act named, a queued pull-back routed to the maintainer at once with the reason, readings cited not restated, skill copies grep-found and corrected in the same PR. Acceptable.
5. **The dequeue measurement and the tooling-child decision — escalated to the triage seat, as the direction reserves it.** The direction's condition for a tooling child ("the claim measures that the platform exposes one") is met by the dev's schema-document reading, not a live one. One observation for that decision, from the code: the relay already executes GraphQL mutations server-side (`PR_MUTATIONS`, run by the `fleet-write` dispatch workflow), so the session egress's GraphQL refusal is not by itself the constraint on a relay `dequeuePullRequest` op; that op would be a new capability and a maintainer ruling, exactly as the card says. Not this PR's scope; no card filed by this review.
6. **The queue-guard refusal text — out of this PR's scope; filed as #20855.** Verified at `05a7547c9` (unchanged on `main` since): `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:1451-:1452` and `:1911-:1912` both print "convert it back to DRAFT (disarming auto-merge alone does NOT dequeue it)". The claim excluded scripts and `scripts/pm/**` is not a governed surface; the guard's `--self-test` is green on this head, so nothing in this PR breaks it. #20855 (open, unlabelled, bare for triage) carries it and should land with or after #20854 so the printed remedy and the rule agree. Escalated via #20855, already filed.
7. **The close-PR candidate act — escalated to the triage seat, correctly not named in the rule.** Verified: `ops.mjs:292-:302` `issue_patch` accepts `state`, so a seat can close a PR through the relay; `.github/workflows/cross-repo-issue-closer.yml:399-:401` asserts closing "drops its merge-queue membership and any armed auto-merge in the same step". No timeline reading of that on a queued PR exists in the inputs, and the dev's reading of GitHub's removal-reason list does not name it. The dev rightly did not attempt it (a mutation). The rule names only measured acts, so its silence on closing is correct. Caution for any future measurement: closing a governed PR is not a reversible pull-back (review state, head-ref handling), so it needs a maintainer ruling before any seat measures it.
8. **Sequencing with #20845 — escalated to the owning seat as a landing-order constraint:** land #20845 (Tier S, draft, needs its own PASS record) first or in the same batch as #20854 (Tier H, maintainer's word). Until #20845 lands, `platform-readings.md:42` contradicts the rule that cites its section, with `AGENTS.md` winning in the window.

This PR is Tier H (`AGENTS.md`, `:272-:275`): this record is not its landing key. The maintainer's authorized APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` remains the key, and the PR stays a draft until then.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20847-agents-draft-dequeue`
Reviewed-by: `session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`

**VERDICT: PASS**
